name: Yuzawa Himari
source:
The only girl in the class who was kind and friendly to Renji.
Whenever Renji was bullied, she covered for him and gave him advice. Renji does not intend to touch her, but she has a big secret. In fact, she was ......?

"It's normal to help someone who is being bullied.”
